decision: option ii (owner-decided 2026-10-15): aggregator only; per-post CSV sections 2-2/10/11 WITHDRAWN history

input.access: read-only; never modified (hash verified before and after each run)

compound_provenance: datasets/cbx-social-trends/methodology.md section 3.1 (query CBX liquid) + metadata/queries/query-registry.json (cbx-liquid-ja -> compound_cbx)

datetime_rules.interpretation: createdAt as UTC; tz-aware values converted to UTC
datetime_rules.missing_or_unparseable: unknown period (empty string); grouped, counted, never guessed
datetime_rules.legacy_week_column: not a grouping key; legacy unknown with valid timestamp recorded as discrepancy (3 rows of 2026-08-31 -> week_start 2026-08-31)

missingness.missing: empty cell stays empty; forms its own group; counted in validation report
missingness.zero: 0 bins to bin 0; never merged with missing
missingness.invalid: negative / decimal / non-numeric counts, bad has_text, naive datetimes are validation errors (fail closed, no partial output)

identifier_removal: allowlist output of 12 columns only; tweet_id_hash, author_id, text, URLs, exact datetimes and exact counts never enter outputs (verified by scan_output_for_identifiers)

classification_codebook.note: aggregation reuses input topic_id/intent_id/format_id as-is; unclassified (fallback) and missing (empty) stay distinct

small_cell_policy: reported, never suppressed or merged (k-anonymity threshold undecided per issue section 8)
platform_language_note: input platform=x_twitter mapped to x and language/ja uniform across all 147 rows; constants carry no grouping information and are not output columns
